verdict.rationale: The evidence shows subscription edits and plan changes only through Orb's own web interface or API. Those are merchant-side admin tools and developer building blocks, not a customer-facing hosted portal or embeddable components. The 'self-serve' agent-pricing page covers customers buying tokens or setting up auto top-up, not upgrading, downgrading, or cancelling through a portal, so there is no evidence of self-serve subscription changes.

support.subject: As a founder, my customers can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel themselves through a hosted portal or embeddable components, without a support ticket
